name: barbell front rack walking lunge
description: A walking lunge with the barbell in a front rack, challenging the legs, balance and core.
instructions: Rest the barbell across your front shoulders with elbows high.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower until both knees reach about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot and bring the back leg through into the next step.
Keep walking, alternating legs, with an upright torso.
